Gold: tee on a lidar pad in rough left of the cart path, about 20 yds ahead of the Buffalo pad; Gold most likely plays from the back of the long rectangular pad right of the path (the Blue/Silver box). Its yardage to the green is 378 there vs card 385 (the lidar pad gives 385). Buffalo tee is fine. Effect is small: Driver either way, the aim moves from -28 to about -16.
